notes.title: ver2.1.0
notes.content:
Mainly, the following contents were modified.
1. Addition of enemy characters
2. Added level elements to items and enemies
3. Addition of obstacles to paint stage

notes.title: Addition of automatic painting, etc.
notes.content:
Added auto paint.
Changed game button assignments.
Other minor modifications.

notes.title: The game was designed as a field exploration type game.
notes.content:
We took the form of exploring the field and finding the stage.
The search area can be expanded by acquiring items.
Three more bosses have been added. We also increased the number of attack methods.
* Some of the bosses' attacks will be fresh and new.
Added one more athletic stage.
Added and modified a few enemies.

notes.title: update

dash when keep tilting the stick.

notes.title: 2019/06/19 update
notes.content:
The following fixes were mainly made.
・A new area has been added.
・A horizontal scroll stage has been added that leads to the boss stage.
・We changed the effect and rules of the match.
*I hope you will play again.

notes.title: 2019/01/27 update
notes.content: We added rules mainly to multi-player game.

notes.title: 2018/12/30 update
notes.content:
A tutorial was added at the time of new play.
We added a new enemy, slime and hermit crab and wizard.
We adjusted some of the enemy's attacks
We adjusted the game balance of the stage, thereby switching the placement of the panel is necessary more than now.
I think that you can enjoy it from the previous version.
